inlet.low_height: U Hermite to zero at floor; k held at lowest allowed measurement below coverage; epsilon length regularized below z0. d0 converts measured ordinates only, never shifts CLS/Yap distance
inlet.interpolation: C1 Hermite U/exact derivative, positive loglinear k/epsilon in native provider

interpretation_erratum.epsilon: The archived input prose overstates exact matching of the log-interpolated finite epsilon completion. Its value at Hw=.015 is .10548224438480716; the independent accepted AWF trace is .1050450587819008. The native constrained projection/Lift imposes the latter. No transported epsilon is overwritten after k.
interpretation_erratum.native_inner_completion: The fresh native inner U is AWF no-slip U scaled to finite U(Hw); inner k is the nonconstant budget-reference solution anchored at completed K(Hw), with natural zero ground flux. It is not the raw inferred RMS completion below Hw.
interpretation_erratum.neutral_metrics: The original eight-step raw reports contain legacy neutral-log scale ratios. These are not experimental reference errors; the final source explicitly labels them diagnostic-only. Use strict finite readbacks and permitted-data queries for actual profile errors.
